text:
Maya: Quick sync — planning a micro-webinar next Tue. Format: 45m demo + 15m office hours. Plan is to seed attendees with free credits (to drive onboarding + prompt usage). Need agreement on credit amount, expiry, inbound lead routing heuristics, and a short launch-post cadence.

Ben: Sounds good. Two asks: 1) a concise benchmark narrative we can drop into launch posts (latency/cost wins) and 2) A/B subject line ideas for the invite.

Rosa: I can draft post + email copy. Need the exact credit amount and expiry window to call out in copy. Tone options: 'Build faster with Redwood' vs 'Cut inference costs in production' — leaning which way?

Sam: Data note: prior seed cohorts converted best with 50-100 credits. Suggest 75 credits + 14-day expiry to encourage quick usage. Also recommend gating to new accounts only to avoid gaming. For routing, surface leads with >10 requests/day signal or >$50/mo projected spend as 'hot'.

Alicia: Ops: we'll map hot leads to the sales queue in HubSpot, others go into a 7-day nurture email + in-app nudge sequence. I can set the Zap and test it. Need tag naming convention (suggest webinar_march2026).

Maya: Good recs. Rosa — can you prep 3 starter prompt templates per persona (developer, product manager, founder) so the onboarding flow has clear next steps?

Rosa: Yep. Also for the launch post I'd like a short benchmark blurb. Question — do we have a safe public line like '95th-pctl latency ~120ms on Dedicated-XL; unit cost ~0.8¢/token (test workload)' or is that too specific?

Sam: Those numbers are from last week's run on the standard bench. They're ok to share as high-level if we add 'test workload' caveat. I'll pull the latest run and paste a permalink to the doc.

webhook-bot: Reminder: webinar signup form will create a HubSpot contact with tag webinar_march2026 and source=webinar.

Ben: A/B subject ideas: A) 'Live demo + $75 credit — build with Redwood' B) 'Cut inference cost by 30% — join our demo' — we should test which value angle wins.

Maya: Action items: Rosa — copy + prompts by Thu EOD; Sam — confirm benchmark numbers and provide a one-line snippet; Alicia — set routing & HubSpot mapping (test in staging); Ben — prepare 2 email variants. I'll schedule the kickoff calendar invite. :rocket:

Rosa: :thumbsup: I'll also loop in design for a hero image — @Jada can you help on visual?

Sam: I'll drop cohort metrics and a tiny chart into the deck today (signup -> activation conversion, avg token burn).

Alicia: I'll create the Zap and run routing smoke tests Thu morning, will report back in this thread.

Ben: Recommend an in-app nudge 24h after signup: 'Need help getting started? Try these starter prompts' linking to promptpack. That tends to lift first-week retention.

Maya: Perfect — if no objections I'll move this into the launch pipeline and tag owners. Thanks team!
